items.title: Tom Albert Interview, 1962-05-07
items.q: Dave Perkins, he used to play tramo with them.

ctx.x: Yeah. He used to use Shield Barquet and Dave Perkins, you know? Yeah, yeah. You know how they get the blomps, you know?
Yeah, I know. Used to change up there, Dave Perkins. Yeah, all of the different guys. Dave Perkins, he used to play tramo with them. Yeah.
You understand? Mattaya played with them.
